title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

Fanatics Collectibles is seeking a Marketing Manager who will be responsible for leading the company’s marketing strategy, primarily focused on the Brazilian market, with additional reach into other Latin American countries. We are looking for an experienced, proactive, hands-on professional who combines strategic vision with strong execution capabilities. Previous experience in the sports industry or with licensed products is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute the company’s marketing plan, focusing on brand growth, consumer engagement, and sales.

• Plan and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns (digital, trade, influencers, events, partnerships) targeting both Brazil and broader Latin America.

• Lead product and license launches, defining communication and activation strategies.

• Manage relationships with agencies, vendors, and strategic partners.

• Collaborate closely with the product, sales, design, and licensing teams to ensure cohesive go-to-market efforts.

• Monitor KPIs and prepare analytical reports to support data-driven decision-making.

• Develop initiatives to strengthen the relationship with the collector community.

• Ensure consistent brand representation across all channels and touchpoints.

• Represent the brand at trade shows, events, and brand activations in Brazil and internationally.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Advertising, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing, including leadership roles.

• Background in sports, entertainment, collectibles, or licensing industries is preferred.

• Dynamic, creative, results-oriented, and highly hands-on profile.

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing, branding, e-commerce, media campaigns, and CRM.

• Intermediate to advanced Spanish and English (desirable for regional coordination).

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

Nice to Have:

• Passion for sports, pop culture, and collectibles.

• Experience with regional campaigns across Latin America.

• Background in startups or fast-growing companies.

• Understanding of collector consumer behavior

title: US Congressional Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to further regulation, industry standards, and safe and beneficial development of AI tools.

About the Role

As a US Congressional Lead on the Global Affairs team, you will help develop strategies and advance OpenAI’s engagement with the U.S. Congress across a range of legislative and policy priorities. You will develop and manage relationships with House and Senate lawmakers and staff, with particular attention to committees shaping technology and emerging policy issues. You will support OpenAI’s U.S. Global Affairs team in meetings, briefings, hearings, and other engagements, and collaborate with civil society and industry partners in alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

OpenAI releases industry-leading research and tools. You will face new challenges as the impact of cutting edge generative AI technologies continues to be explored and as the needs of the organization evolve. Day-to-day work may encompass tracking emerging congressional policy issues, coordinating complex cross-functional engagement with legal, policy, and communications teams, developing briefing materials, preparing our leaders for congressional hearings and other government engagements, and representing OpenAI in private and public forums.

We are looking for a self-directed and creative individual with substantial Capitol Hill experience, strong congressional relationships, experience managing private sector and civil society relationships, and an understanding of AI-related legislative and regulatory issues and processes.

This role is based in Washington, DC and may require frequent travel to participate in meetings and events with key stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are well versed in the issues around emerging AI technologies, particularly as they relate to congressional policymaking.

- Are an enthusiastic and effective coalition builder who thrives as a member of a high performing, peer-led global team.

- Are highly organized, and are used to working as an accountable individual contributor as well as a team player.

- Are passionate about the promise of technology and the future of artificial intelligence but thoughtful about its potential risks.

We're looking for a blend of:

- Demonstrated experience (8+ years) and credibility working with the U.S. federal government, particularly the legislative branch.

- Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the U.S. government, its institutions and legislative processes, and the key policy issues and debates related to AI.

- The ideal candidate will have substantial experience working with Congress, with a strong preference for experience working with the House or Senate Judiciary Committees, the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, or other relevant congressional committees. The candidate should bring strong bipartisan relationships, sound political judgment, and demonstrated experience navigating complex legislative and policy issues.

- Sound judgment and outstanding personal integrity

- Ability to execute in fast and flexible environments through rapid cycles of analysis, decision, and action

title: Threat Investigator
description:
About 10a Labs : 10a Labs is the safety and threat-intelligence layer trusted by frontier AI labs, AI unicorns, Fortune 10 companies, and leading global technology platforms. Our adversarial red teaming, model evaluations, and intelligence collection enable engineering, safety, and security teams to stay ahead of evolving threats and deploy AI systems safely.

10a Labs ’ Investigations Team is seeking additional support to respond to critical safety incidents and conduct investigations across a range of abuse areas, including but not limited to violence, hate, mental health, CBRNE, child safety, and cyber abuse.
This role requires the ability to work Pacific Time (PT) hours and have valid work authorization in the United States.
About the Role:
As a Threat Investigator , you will be supporting our Investigations Team and responsible for detecting and/or responding to malicious uses and abuse, investigating the activity, drafting reports based on your findings, and making recommendations. This will require technical experience investigating threat actors, harmful behaviors, and/or other activities; as well as a strong ability to use SQL and Python to query, transform, and understand data. You will also respond to escalations and reactive leads, including those that are not caught by our existing safety systems.
Investigations involve sensitive and distressing content, including sexual, violent, or otherwise-disturbing material.
This role includes serving in an on-call capacity that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, occasionally including evenings and weekends. The typical on-call rotation is 7 consecutive days per 2 months, though this may shift based on operational needs and candidates should be prepared to remain flexible.
This is a remote, full-time position.
In this role, you will:

• Proactively detect and reacquire bad actors on our platform.

• Investigate potentially policy-violating activity by querying internal data sources (using SQL and Python) and cross-referencing open source information (OSINT).

• Document and share investigative findings with internal stakeholders.

Requirements:

• At least 3+ years of related investigative experience in Trust & Safety, National Security, Defense, Intelligence, or Law Enforcement domains working on related topics; must be willing to work on sensitive subject matter including child safety.

• U.S.-based, with the ability to work West Coast hours (9am - 5pm PT).

• Ability to be on-call that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, including occasional evenings and weekends.

• Strong SQL and Python proficiency and/or additional programming skills.

• Strong and applicable technical investigative skillset with ability to develop and maintain detection pipelines.

• Ability to rapidly context switch across domains, modalities, and abuse areas.

• Excited to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, and purposeful space with high impact across users and beyond.

Preferred Qualities (but not required):

• Expertise with risk and abuse related to AI platforms.

• Full professional proficiency in Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, Portuguese, Russian, or Spanish.

• Have experience scaling and automating detection and mitigation processes.

• Familiarity using language models to scale.

• Familiarity with one of the following topics/areas: violence, extremism,, child safety, digital mental health, scams and fraud abuse, radicalization/persuasion/grooming, hateful activities and groups.

title: Senior Producer, HUB
description:
The E.W. Scripps Co is looking for a creative Senior Producer who will work remotely, one-on-one with stations to produce local newscasts. We’re looking for someone who can produce a show with little oversight, and quickly assess the content needs of local news markets across the country. This Producer should have the desire to craft newscasts in new, and innovative ways. The Sr Producer will also work to showcase content on digital platforms. Remote work is approved only for specific geographic locations. This position requires schedule flexibility.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Produce local newscast for stations across Scripps local media markets.

• Work directly with local station news leadership and other key employees to select the most up-to-date information for the daypart.

• Exercise solid news judgement and creativity to produce a dynamic product following the Scripps content strategy.

• Execute time sensitive decisions with independence and clear messaging.

• Act as an ambassador for the Scripps Content Strategy.

• Oversee newscast and up-to-the-minute editorial decisions.

• Be open to sharing ideas on creating content in a new and unique way.

• Showcase content on local stations digital platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

• BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience.

• Generally 6+ years of experience as a television news producer preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• Avid news consumer, knows where to find news and how to get up to speed on local news happening in Scripps markets across the country.

• Excellent time management skills, highly organized, and deadline-driven.

• Able to build relationships quickly, communicate assertively, and influence without authority.

• Experience with editing software in a newsroom environment.

• Strong critical thinker with the ability to adapt on the fly in challenging situations.

• Creative and curious to learn new styles of producing news.

• Exceptional news writing.

• Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.

• Ability and desire to learn and test new technology.

• Travel may be required.

• Flexible work hours are required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

title: Customer Success Manager - US & Canada
description:
Location: Remote - East Coast time zone required
Reporting to: Customer Success Lead / CRO
Scope: Core North America accounts, including professional sports teams and Division I athletics departments

About Storyteller
Storyteller is a SaaS platform that helps media companies, sports organisations, and content-driven brands engage their audiences through modern, short-form experiences across their owned and operated platforms.

Trusted by some of the most recognised organisations in global media and sport, Storyteller sits at the intersection of content, technology, and audience engagement, helping teams move faster, work smarter, and build deeper relationships with their audiences.

The Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of core North America accounts across professional sports teams and Division I athletics departments.

This role is a strong fit for someone earlier in their Customer Success career who has the judgment, organisation, and curiosity to work with sports and media customers where content calendars, live moments, fan engagement, and commercial pressure all matter.

You will be the day-to-day customer owner for your accounts, helping teams get value from Storyteller , driving adoption, spotting risk early, and identifying opportunities for customers to expand how they use our products over time.

This is not a frontline support or implementation role. You will coordinate closely with delivery,
support, sales, and product, but your focus is customer outcomes, account health, adoption,
and growth.
What You’ll Do:

Account Ownership (Player)

• Own a portfolio of core North America customer accounts

• Build strong working relationships with digital, content, marketing, fan engagement, sponsorship, and athletics stakeholders

• Understand each customer's goals, season calendar, workflows, and measures of success

• Run regular customer check-ins that are useful, structured, and outcome-led

• Maintain clear visibility on account health, risks, next steps, and opportunities

Adoption and Value

• Help customers adopt Storyteller effectively across their apps, websites, and content workflows

• Translate product usage and engagement data into clear recommendations

• Spot under-used features, low adoption, or workflow gaps before they become renewal risks

• Help customers plan around key moments such as season launch, playoffs, tournaments, rivalry games, and major campaigns

• Share best practices across teams without relying on generic playbooks

Commercial Contribution

• Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts

• Understand where Storyteller and our wider suite of new products could support broader customer goals

• Surface commercial signals to Sales with useful context and customer insight

• Support renewal preparation by keeping account status, value, risks, and stakeholder context clear

• Develop confidence in commercial conversations without needing to fully own the sales process

Internal Coordination

• Coordinate with delivery and support teams to make sure customer needs are handled cleanly

• Bring product feedback back to the business with enough context to be useful

• Keep internal account notes, actions, and risks accurate and current

• Escalate issues with judgment, urgency, and a clear view of customer impact

• Help improve repeatable CS processes as the team scales

What Success Looks Like
First 90 days

• Clear understanding of Storyteller , our customer base, and the North America sports landscape

• Smooth transition of assigned accounts with strong customer confidence

• Accurate view of account health, adoption, risks, and upcoming key moments

• Running customer calls independently with clear structure and follow-through

title: Prototype Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical & Fluid Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Prototype Manufacturing Engineer to execute first builds and prototype manufacturing across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans the full AD&S portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions - and is designed for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, builds hardware with incomplete inputs, and treats every first build as an opportunity to generate the manufacturing knowledge that makes future production possible.

As a Prototype ME, you are the first manufacturing engineer on a new build. You will work from incomplete design definitions - often without released drawings or established work instructions - to figure out how hardware goes together, build the first units, and document what you learn. Your output is not just a built prototype; it is the MVP work instructions, preliminary BOM structure, buildability feedback, and lessons learned that the DFx and SME teams use to drive producibility improvements and prepare for rate production. You are the bridge between a design engineer's intent and the physical reality of how something gets built for the first time.

This is a cross-program role. You will move between AD&S programs based on where first builds are happening, bringing a consistent methodology to new hardware regardless of the product line. You will work closely with design engineers, DFx engineers, SME manufacturing engineers, and production technicians. The pace is fast, the inputs are messy, and the expectation is that you bring order to chaos - one build at a time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Execute first builds of new mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid system hardware across AD&S programs, working from preliminary or incomplete design inputs (unreleased models, draft drawings, verbal direction from design engineers).

• Develop MVP work instructions during and immediately after first builds - capturing assembly sequences, tooling needs, critical dimensions, torque values, and process notes sufficient for a technician to repeat the build.

• Establish preliminary BOM structures (Make/Buy determinations) based on first-build experience, identifying which components should be fabricated internally, procured, or sent to contract manufacturers.

• Provide structured design feedback to design engineers based on first-build observations - specifically addressing buildability, checkability (can you inspect it?), and repeatability (can someone else build it the same way?).

• Document lessons learned from every first build and feed them directly to DFx engineers for incorporation into formal DFM/DFA reviews and design trade studies.

• Build and support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) units - Ironbirds, Copperbirds, and similar integration test articles - where the build method is undefined and must be figured out from scratch.

• Identify and resolve manufacturing issues in real time on the shop floor during first builds, including fit/interference problems, fastener access issues, routing conflicts, and assembly sequence challenges.

• Develop or source prototype tooling, fixtures,

- Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

- Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

- Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

- Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

- Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

- Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

- Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

- Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

- Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

- Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

- Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

- Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

- Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

- Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

Preferably, you also have experience with at least some of the following:

- Experience as a technical lead making architectural design decisions.

- Github CI/CD.

- Cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP.

- Building product features on top of LLMs.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We move fast - really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed.

After submitting your application, the team reviews your CV and statement of exceptional work. If your application passes this stage, you will be invited to a 30-minute interview during which a member of our team will make sure you're a good fit for the role. You will have the opportunity ask questions and learn more about the role as well.

We'll then send you a programming challenge that consists of two parts: LeetCode and React. Beyond that step, you will enter the main process, which consists of three interviews:

1. Experience, theory, and system design.

2. Live coding.

3. Product thinking and past work.

Our goal is to finish the process within one week. All interviews will be conducted via Google Meet.

HOW WE WORK

- Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.

- Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.

- Fun Is a Feature - Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.

- In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

- Competitive salary + early-stage equity

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Company provided lunch in office everyday

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
About the team
The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.

We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.

PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products. About the role
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation.
In this role, you will:

• Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that make cloud capabilities self-service: account provisioning, networking, IAM, and policy exposed as clean software interfaces rather than tickets or manual processes.

• Turn recurring cloud work into products. Take patterns that today depend on human judgment or hand-run runbooks and encode them into APIs, controls, and automation that are safe by default.

• Treat teams across Zillow as the customers of your platform: understand their use cases, shape the interfaces and paved paths they build on, and let their feedback and usage data drive your roadmap.

• Own the reliability of what you build. Design for observability, SLOs, and self-healing so the platform runs itself. Like any team that owns services in production, you'll be on call for what you ship, and you'll lead the follow-up work that removes whole classes of problems rather than patching individual incidents.

• Use modern AI-assisted and agentic tooling to accelerate design, implementation, and operations while keeping quality and safety high.

• Influence how Platform Engineering approaches public cloud enablement, bringing a product mindset to design discussions and roadmap decisions.

You'll help take a set of foundational capabilities and turn them into a cohesive, self-service platform that Zillow engineers experience as a product, not a queue.

title: Security Operations Analyst - West Coast
description:
Reports to: Manager, Security Operations Center
Location: Remote, US
Compensation Range: $100,000-$125,000 base plus bonus and equity. This role may be eligible for on-call/call-in pay in addition to base pay
*The initial training period for this position will be Monday-Friday. Following training, the work schedule is subject to change and may include weekend or a 4x10 shift, depending on business requirements*
What We Do:
Huntress is a fully remote, global team of passionate experts and ethical badasses on a mission to break down the barriers to cybersecurity. Whether creating purpose-built security solutions, hunting down hackers, or impacting our community, our people go above and beyond to change the security game and make a real difference.
Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress protects all businesses-not just the 1%-with enterprise-grade, fully owned, and managed cybersecurity products at the price of an affordable SaaS application. The Huntress difference is our One Team advantage: our technology is designed with our industry-defining Security Operations Center (SOC) in mind and is never separated from our service.
We protect 4M+ endpoints and 7M+ identities worldwide, elevating underresourced IT teams with protection that works as hard as they do. As long as hackers keep hacking, Huntress keeps hunting.
What You’ll Do:
Huntress is looking for a Security Operations Center Analyst to add to our growing team. In this role, you will get to triage, investigate, respond, and remediate a variety of intrusions on a daily basis. You’ll be surrounded by passionate individuals who are mission-driven to help protect companies around the world from cyberattacks and will have daily opportunities to progress your analyst skillset and accelerate your career growth.

The Huntress Security Operations Center is an elite team of individuals who wake up every day to combat threat actors. You will have daily opportunities to progress your analysis skills while being at the forefront of what’s happening in the wild. If you’re looking to accelerate your career and skills, this is the team for you!
Responsibilities:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to alerts coming in from the Huntress platform.

• Perform tactical review of EDR telemetry, log sources, and forensic artifacts to determine the root cause of attacks, where possible, and provide remediations needed to remove the threat.

• Perform tactical malware analysis as part of investigating and triaging alerts.

• Investigate suspicious Microsoft M365 activity and provide remediations.

• Assist in escalations from the Product Support team for threat-related and SOC-relevant questions.

• Contribute to detection engineering creation and tuning efforts.

• Contribute to projects focused on driving better outcomes for our analysts and partners

• Contribute to our collaboratively mentored team (we're all here to make each other better!).

What You Bring To The Team:

• 2+ years of experience in a SOC or Digital Forensics (DFIR) role

• Demonstrated experience with Windows, Linux, and MacOS as an attack surface

• Demonstrated experience with basic Threat Actor tools and techniques: (MITRE ATT&CK Framework, PowerShell & Command Prompt Terminals, WMIC, Scheduled Tasks, SCM, Windows Domain and host Enumeration Techniques, Basic Lateral Movement Techniques, Basic Persistence Mechanisms, Basic Defense Evasion Techniques, other offensive/Red Team TTPs)

• Demonstrated experience with static and dynamic malware analysis concepts

• Working knowledge of Windows Administration or Enterprise Domain Administration

• Active Directory, Group Policy, Domain Trusts, etc.

• Working knowledge of core networking concepts

• Common ports/protocols, NAT, Public/Private IPs, VLANs, etc.

• Working knowledge of web technologies and concepts

• Web servers/applications, OWASP top 10, etc.

• Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain complex events to less technical audiences

title: Principal Software Engineer – AI CoE
description:
Principal Software Engineer - AI CoE  

About Redwood  

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.  

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.  

Role Mission  

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of complex, production-grade AI and agentic capabilities that can be reused across Redwood products.  

You will solve ambiguous engineering problems, establish standards for reliability and AI evaluation, and contribute to important technical decisions. This is a hands-on role with ownership of significant systems and platform capabilities.

• Design and deliver complex services, agentic workflows, and shared AI platform capabilities.

• Build multi-step agentic systems that combine reasoning, tool use, retrieval, memory, policy controls, and human oversight.

• Lead the technical execution of initiatives involving multiple contributors and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Balance short-term delivery requirements with long-term platform maintainability and scalability.

Must Have Qualifications  

• 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.

• Advanced programming skills in Python, Java, or another relevant production language.

• Strong experience building distributed systems, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and production-grade applications.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- 2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting.

- Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning

- Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights.

- Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with dbt or modern data stacks.

- Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation.

- Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.
Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.
Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.
Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.
L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.
🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.
Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de recherche et innovation et, dans une moindre mesure de nos missions d’enseignement. Vous serez affecté au centre SPIN - LGF (Laboratoire Georges Friedel, UMR CNRS 5307). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.
Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux. Il possède également des compétences en développement de capteurs et d’instrumentation.
Les technologies de captage et stockage du CO2 sont des technologies clés pour la décarbonation du secteur industriel. Les stockages offshores ont déjà démontré leur faisabilité, mais les stockages onshores semblent nécessaires pour augmenter les capacités de stockage tout en réduisant le transport de CO2. Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale.
La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2.
Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN,

title: Strategic Client Success Manager
description:
Job Description
Position Overview
The Strategic Client Success Manager is the relationship anchor for Momentive's most strategic enterprise clients. In this role, you own the full client experience after implementation - from onboarding through long-term adoption and renewal readiness - and serve as the trusted point of contact for a defined portfolio of Tier 1 accounts. You are accountable for client health and retention, not just client satisfaction.

Position Summary
This role sits within the Account Management structure and owns the post-implementation relationship with Momentive's Tier 1 enterprise clients. You are responsible for driving measurable outcomes - product adoption, tracking & improving client health,, value realization, and gross revenue retention - across a defined portfolio of high-value accounts. You will build executive-level relationships, orchestrate cross-functional resources, and translate client goals into clear, structured success plans. You report to the Director, Account Management and work in close partnership with Account Managers, Implementation, Support, and Product to deliver one connected client experience.

It is important for us to maintain a strong connection with the core client success organization to share methods, best practices and insights gleaned from clients to drive product innovation and organization performance improvements. To ensure this connection is strong, the Director, Account Management and team will have a dotted line to the leader of Client Success

This role works collaboratively with the Account Manager and the goal is to keep and grow the client relationship.

A Day in the Life

• Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of Tier 1 enterprise clients post-implementation, owning the full client experience from onboarding through renewal.

• Lead structured onboarding for new enterprise clients - establish success plans, define adoption milestones, and ensure a seamless transition from implementation to sustained product use.

• Monitor and manage client health across your portfolio, product utilization data, NPS, and stakeholder sentiment; act early when risk appears, not after a contract is already at risk.

• Build and maintain relationships at multiple levels of the client organization, including C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, to embed Momentive as a strategic partner.

• Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with senior client stakeholders that connect product usage to the client's strategic goals and demonstrate clear value delivered.

• Own renewal readiness for your accounts: build the case well before contract dates, flag risk early, and coordinate with the Account Manager to ensure timely, confident renewals.

• Orchestrate cross-functional resources - Support, Product, Implementation, and Professional Services - to resolve client issues and keep accounts progressing.

• Track and report against key outcome metrics for your portfolio: Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), health scores, NPS, and product utilization.

• Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce, including success plans, health notes, stakeholder maps, and renewal timelines

• Bring client feedback and portfolio-level patterns back to Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership so the roadmap and messaging reflect what enterprise clients need.

• Partner with the Account Manager on account strategy - coordinating on accounts with both retention and growth activity and contributing to a unified account plan.

• Build and refine scalable playbooks for onboarding, health recovery, and executive engagement that raise the bar for the entire Tier 1 segment.

We are looking for someone who brings

Experience:

• 5+ years in Client Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role in B2B SaaS, with direct experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.

• A demonstrable track record of driving adoption, improving health scores, and retaining complex, high-value accounts against

title: Life Science Solution Marketing Manager (Maternity cover)
description:
Job Title
Life Science Solution Marketing Manager (Maternity cover)

Location(s)

Poland - Remote (Home Based) About Us
Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.
Find your future at Revvity
The Solutions Marketing Manager will develop and execute annual marketing plans focused on key customer segments, applications, and scientific workflows. This individual will partner closely with Product Management, Commercial teams, Regional Marketing, and Marketing Centers of Excellence to create solution-based positioning, campaigns, content strategies, and demand generation programs that highlight the value of Revvity ’s end-to-end capabilities.
This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to connect technologies across the portfolio into impactful solutions that address customer pain points and drive measurable business outcomes. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience building strategic marketing programs, influencing cross-functional teams, and executing initiatives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.
Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute solution marketing strategies that align customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities across Life Sciences applications and workflows.

• Build a deep understanding of customer personas, scientific challenges, market trends, and buying behaviors through customer insights, VOC, and market analysis.

• Create differentiated solution positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions that communicate the impact of Revvity ’s technologies and capabilities.

• Lead integrated marketing planning for strategic solutions, including campaign strategy, content development, digital programs, events, and commercial enablement.

• Partner with Product Management teams to connect individual technologies into broader workflow-based solutions that address customer challenges.

• Partner with Commercial SMEs

• Support go-to-market strategies for new innovations and solution launches, ensuring alignment across Marketing, Commercial, and Regional teams.

• Develop customer journey-based content strategies that support awareness, education, engagement, and conversion.

• Partner with Sales Enablement teams to create tools and messaging that help commercial teams effectively communicate solution value.

• Analyze campaign performance, customer engagement, and marketing KPIs to continuously optimize programs and demonstrate business impact.

• Monitor competitive activity, market dynamics, and emerging scientific trends to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

• Manage marketing budgets and prioritize investments based on strategic impact and measurable outcomes.

• Drive collaboration across global matrix teams while ensuring brand consistency and executional excellence.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 8 years of marketing experience within Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, CRO, or related industries; degree in Marketing, Life Sciences, Business, or related discipline preferred.

• Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic marketing plans, solution-based campaigns, content strategies, and demand generation programs that drive measurable business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of customer workflows, market dynamics, and the ability to translate technical information into compelling value propositions, messaging, and customer-focused content.

• Experience building integrated marketing programs across digital and traditional channels, including web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social media, marketing automation, and analytics.

title: Senior Revenue Systems Specialist
description:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone - so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse , you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist to join our team!
Revenue Systems owns the go-to-market technology stack at Greenhouse , from first outreach through renewal. As a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist, you’ll own systems work across both pre-sale and post-sale: Salesforce, our sales system of record, and the platforms our Customer Success and Customer Marketing teams work from every day, currently Gainsight and Accord. Breadth is a key aspect of this role, and you’ll have real latitude to shape where the stack goes next.
Who will love this job

•
A systems generalist - you enjoy working across a stack rather than being confined to one corner of it, and you’re comfortable moving to where the work is

•
A solutions-oriented partner - you can hear what the business is trying to accomplish and turn it into something that works, and you stay with a problem until the desired outcome is achieved

•
A curious builder - you want to understand why a process exists before you automate it, and you’re comfortable saying when something doesn’t seem to make sense, including to the people asking for it

•
An owner - you take a project from first conversation through rollout and adoption without needing it project-managed for you

•
An AI-fluent operator - you already use tools like Claude, Glean, or ChatGPT in your day to day, and you’re interested in what they can do inside a revenue stack

What you’ll do

• Own and build solutions in Salesforce, including data model design, declarative automation, validation, permissions, page layouts, and reporting, taking projects from scoping and intake through rollout, adoption, and documentation

• Administer our post-sale platforms, including Gainsight and Accord, alongside our Customer Success Operations team, covering the rules engine, journey and email programs, surveys including NPS, and the workflows behind customer health scoring, CSM assignment, and account transfers

• Own integrations between Salesforce, Gainsight, and the rest of the stack, standing up new ones independently and eliminating the recurring failures that come with the existing ones

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Customer Marketing on their requests, working out whether the fix belongs in a system or somewhere else, and seeing it through to a working solution either way

• Lead platform migration and consolidation work as our tech stack changes, from evaluation and vendor assessment through data movement, cutover, and adoption

• Hold a point of view on where the stack should go, surfacing the opportunities and the risks in our implementation rather than waiting to be asked

• Document what you build, and bring request volume down over time through automation and self-service

• Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

• Several years in revenue operations, customer success operations, business systems, or platform administration.

• B2B SaaS experience.

• Deep hands-on Salesforce administration experience: data model design, declarative automation, permissions and sharing, reporting, and the judgment to know when not to build. You should be comfortable making medium to large changes to a production org and reasoning about the performance and scale implications of your configuration choices.
